name: test_collection_lists_system
description: The ComputerSystem the host power events use as OriginOfCondition is a member of the collection

name: test_system_returns_200
description: GET of the ComputerSystem succeeds on SONiC even though the optional OpenBMC providers (xyz.openbmc_project.Settings, serial console socket units) are not on the bus

name: test_system_reports_power_state
description: PowerState is present so a rack manager can read the host state after a ResourcePoweredOn/Off event

name: test_system_advertises_reset_action
description: ComputerSystem.Reset is discoverable from the resource rather than only by a hard-coded URI

name: test_reset_action_info_matches_accepted_reset_types
description: ResetActionInfo advertises exactly the ResetTypes the POST path accepts (the four backed by a RACK_MANAGER_COMMAND); Nmi and ForceOn must not be offered

name: test_reset_on_accepted
description: HLD ResetType On (POWER_ON) is accepted: bmcweb maps it to Host.Transition.On and the bridge queues it

name: test_reset_force_off_accepted
description: HLD ResetType ForceOff (POWER_OFF) is accepted: bmcweb maps it to Chassis.Transition.Off and the bridge queues it

name: test_reset_graceful_shutdown_accepted
description: HLD ResetType GracefulShutdown (GRACEFUL_SHUT) is accepted: bmcweb maps it to Host.Transition.Off and the bridge queues it

name: test_reset_power_cycle_accepted
description: HLD ResetType PowerCycle (POWER_CYCLE) is accepted: bmcweb maps it to Host.Transition.Reboot and the bridge queues it

name: test_reset_force_restart_not_supported
description: ForceRestart is a valid Redfish ResetType but is not in the HLD list, so it is rejected with ActionParameterNotSupported instead of being forwarded to the bridge

name: test_reset_unknown_type_rejected
description: A ResetType outside the Redfish enum is rejected with ActionParameterUnknown
